safety_verdicts.content: Patient is taking the Clenil inhaler every day, 2 puffs twice daily.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated confirms Clenil is used daily but does not document the baseline dose of 2 puffs twice daily (meds-002 states dose not confirmed).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the patient’s baseline Clenil dose (2 puffs twice daily) reduces clarity about the starting controller regimen during an exacerbation and can lead to incorrect step-up/step-down instructions or inaccurate medication reconciliation. This is unlikely to directly cause severe injury but can result in suboptimal asthma management and additional follow-up/monitoring.
